notes.text: First test build of GodotHub Beta, the Flutter rewrite of GodotHub. It installs next to the stable app and starts from a copy of its data.
Window, title bar, theme, fonts, icons, animations and all 9 languages are in place. Most screens are not ported yet.

known_issues: Most views from the stable app are still missing.

notes.text: In-app updater: downloads, verifies and applies updates by itself, with no external installer
Update log that lists every file as it is downloaded and installed
Restart to Apply Update button in the sidebar when an update is downloaded but the app has not restarted yet
Automatic rollback to the previous version if an update fails to start
Remaining integrations: Opener, Git, Discord etc.
Smoother scrolling and dragging, with no stutter the first time an effect is drawn
Uses less memory than the stable app
Remaining differences from the stable app
